title: Yoneda: morphisms of representable presheaves
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and for an object $A$ let $h_A$ be the presheaf of sets $X\mapsto\operatorname{Mor}_{\mathcal C}(X,A)$ on $\mathcal C$. For objects $A,B$ of $\mathcal C$ the map

$$
\operatorname{Mor}_{\mathcal C}(A,B)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}(h_A,h_B),\qquad g\longmapsto(g\circ-),
$$

to the set of natural transformations $h_A\to h_B$ is a bijection, with inverse $\tau\mapsto\tau_A(\mathrm{id}_A)$.
